memories.content: The user stores copies of identity documents in an encrypted folder.
On a day the user transferred between buses twice, they rested for an hour after the trip.
On a day the user took a direct route with a similar travel time, they remained seated to the destination.
After arriving at an entrance with stairs only, the user went around to an entrance on the other side of the building.
On a day the user checked the accessible entrance location in advance, they arrived before the agreed time.
On a rainy day, the user's clothes became wet while crossing an uncovered section at a transfer stop.
On a day the user traveled with their maternal uncle, they agreed to meet at an entrance near the elevator.
The user's maternal uncle prefers an aisle seat from which it is easy to stand during long-distance travel.
The local agent cannot know whether an accessible entrance is operating that day from past route records alone.
The transfer route the user takes has more boarding and alighting events and walking segments than the direct route.
The user stores wrapping paper and empty gift boxes on the upper shelf of the bedroom closet.
From photographs, the user discovered that they had given their mother the same type of kitchen item two years in a row.
This year, the user went to the market with their mother and let her choose a needed item directly.
The user once ordered a gift late and had it delivered the day after the gathering.
The next year, the user checked the expected delivery date and ordered one week before the gathering.
The user did not put names on wrapped boxes and handed their older sister and younger brother each other's gifts.
The next time the user wrapped gifts, they wrote the recipient on the bottom of each box.
The user's younger brother welcomes a snack the family can share immediately more than an item for his use alone.
The local agent can find past gift records and flag duplicates but cannot know what is needed this year.
Year-end deliveries may take longer than usual or have their expected dates changed.

analysis.overview: The frames contain independent information in separate domains: the reference frame concerns identity-document storage, accessible travel, route effort, and related uncertainty, while the compared frame concerns gift storage, selection, ordering, labeling, recipient preferences, and delivery uncertainty. No claims address the same operational decision closely enough to relate.
